summary: SMART goal processor fails to update confidence scores despite users providing specific, detailed answers

root_cause.description: The AI prompt explicitly constrains confidence scores to 0.3-0.5 range and prevents proper score updates even when users provide comprehensive information

problematic_prompt_rules: Keep confidence LOW (0.3-0.5) unless the user provided comprehensive details
ONLY update the specific component(s) the user addressed
DO NOT add details the user didn't provide (no timeframes, metrics, or assessments they didn't mention)
DO NOT assume achievability or relevance without the user confirming it

bug_reproduction.step1: User provides initial goal (e.g., 'Learn to race')
bug_reproduction.step3: System asks for more specific details
bug_reproduction.step4: User provides detailed answer (e.g., 'hobby racing at local track')
bug_reproduction.step5: System updates specific component but keeps confidence artificially low (30-50%)
bug_reproduction.step6: System continues asking for information already implicitly provided

impact.user_experience: Frustrating loop where users repeatedly provide information but system fails to recognize improvements
impact.functionality: Core SMART goal refinement process is broken
impact.data_flow: Confidence scores remain stuck at low values despite quality improvements

proposed_fix.approach: Revise the buildClarificationPrompt method to allow dynamic confidence scoring based on answer quality
changes_needed: Allow AI to properly evaluate answer comprehensiveness
Enable updating multiple components if user's answer addresses them
Add logic to recognize when sufficient information has been provided
proposed_fix.example_revised_prompt: Evaluate the user's input objectively. If they provided specific, measurable details, update confidence accordingly (0.7-1.0 for comprehensive answers). Update all components their answer addresses.

test_cases_needed: Test confidence score increases appropriately with detailed answers
Test multiple components update when answer addresses multiple criteria
Test system recognizes when clarification is complete
Test edge cases with partial or ambiguous answers
